conclusion.helper_runs: 0x674EB0 is entered about 280 times per second -- my earlier 'never called' conclusion (from the spin test and from the one-shot breakpoint) was WRONG
conclusion.why_the_spin_failed: EB FE only freezes if the code is actually executed there; the fact that it did not freeze means the spin patch was reverted or never took effect in that run (most likely the launcher's debugging/reinstall patch chain rewrote the bytes)

root_cause_found.0x674E10: NET_CompareAdr: compares the netadr type at [edx]/[ecx]; when equal it compares further fields; for type==5 it compares the port at +8 (movzx eax,word [edx+8] vs [ecx+8])
root_cause_found.bridge_default_port: ring_bridge --port defaults to 0, and inject_oob_raw writes socket.htons(port) into the injected netadr, so every server packet is stamped with source port 0
root_cause_found.client_expectation: the client's netchan remote address is 127.0.0.1:28970 from the connect handshake
root_cause_found.effect: 0x674E10 reports a mismatch, 0x674EB0 returns 0, 0x5C238A je returns from the parser -- every snapshot is silently discarded

fix: pass --port 28970 to the bridge forward (or change the default) so injected packets carry the server port the client expects
